title: Select and Filter Records
scenario: Use the synthetic data described below to practise b, o, o, l, e, a, n,  , a, n, d,  , a, d, v, a, n, c, e, d,  , f, i, l, t, e, r, i, n, g. Do not assume the input is correct without validating it.

starter.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"product": ["Tea", "Coffee", "Juice", "Water"], "units": [2, 1, 4, 3], "price": [12, 35, 18, 8]})

filtered = df.loc[(df["units"] >= 2) & (df["price"] < 30), ["product", "units", "price"]]
print(filtered)
